lane: exact claim-evidence provenance for scientific mapping witnesses

projections.projection: The standard defines TextQuoteSelector and TextPositionSelector, including exact quoted text, optional surrounding context and character positions.
projections.rakl_effect: Treat exact span selectors as prior art; reuse the structural idea while adding RAKL-specific freeze/source-identity/authority rules.

projections.source: Can AI Validate Science? Benchmarking LLMs on Claim → Evidence Reasoning in AI Papers
projections.projection: CLAIM-BENCH evaluates more than 300 scientific claim-evidence pairs and reports significant model limitations; multi-pass linking improves performance at additional cost.
projections.rakl_effect: Generic claim-evidence linking and validation are prior art and empirically nontrivial; use matched real benchmarks rather than assuming an LLM can supply semantic relation labels reliably.

projections.projection: Open-source biomedical evidence extraction data include sentence-level evidence annotations with human validation and a larger automatically annotated corpus.
projections.rakl_effect: Provides a plausible future real-corpus route for exact-span versus source-level provenance ablations; evidence extraction benchmarks are not a RAKL novelty.

projections.source: PaperTrail: A Claim-Evidence Interface for Grounding Provenance in LLM-based Scholarly Q&A
projections.projection: PaperTrail decomposes scholarly answers and sources into claims and evidence because citation-level provenance is too coarse for rigorous verification.
projections.rakl_effect: Granular scholarly claim-evidence provenance is prior art; RAKL narrows its contribution to fail-closed evidence governance and authority boundaries.

projections.source: ProvenanceGuard: Source-Aware Factuality Verification for MCP-Based LLM Agents
projections.projection: The work treats source attribution as an independent axis from pooled factual support and reports that joint source-plus-relation accuracy can remain difficult when sources are semantically close.
projections.rakl_effect: Keep source/span identity separate from semantic evidence relation; exact locator fidelity cannot substitute for relation validation.

projections.source: ProvenAI: Provenance-Native Traces of Evidence in Generated Answers
projections.projection: The framework separates answer correctness, citation fidelity and per-document behavioral influence under intervention.
projections.rakl_effect: Do not conflate evidence support provenance with causal generation influence. Round 030 intentionally validates only source/span identity plus externally supplied evidence-review records.

retained_new_rakl_semantic_objects: exact locator fidelity is structurally distinct from semantic evidence relation
exact source snapshot identity plus span chronology can fail closed on stale or post-hoc evidence links
proposed-versus-reviewed support/refutation disagreement is preserved as a typed contradiction
neither exact span provenance nor a reviewed relation record grants scientific/target authority
